page_title: Build & ship web & mobile apps with AI and no-code

sources.entry: Bubble - Bubble is a no-code platform that allows users to build web applications with ease, integrating AI functionalities like chatbots and content generation. #freemium

summary.name: Bubble
summary.one_liner: Bubble is a visual no-code platform for building and launching web and native mobile apps, with an AI Agent that builds apps from a text description and a fully visual editor for manual changes.
use_cases: Building a SaaS product without writing code
Creating a marketplace or community platform
Making internal tools for a company
Shipping iOS and Android apps that share data with a web app
Adding AI features or LLM integrations to an app
Launching a subscription or payment-based app
summary.what_it_does: Bubble lets users build web apps and native iOS and Android apps by chatting with its AI Agent, by editing visually, or both. Every component is visual, including the backend, workflows, database and privacy rules, and the Agent can explain what it built. Hosting, a built-in database, security and auto-scaling are included for web and native mobile. Mobile apps can share data and workflows with the web app and be submitted to the App Store and Google Play. The platform can connect to tools such as LLMs and payment providers, and the Agent can set up those connections.
notable: AI Agent that builds and troubleshoots apps, with a fully visual editor for precise control
Native iOS and Android apps sharing data and workflows with the web app
Built-in privacy rules and SOC 2 Type II compliant platform
Connects to LLMs, payment providers, and Claude or Codex via Bubble MCP (beta)
caveats: You don't pay until you launch; plans beyond Free are paid, and the page doesn't give plan prices
Native mobile app features, in-app purchases and the Bubble MCP are marked BETA
Agent usage is limited by a monthly allowance per plan, so heavy use may need more credits
